Tariq just walked back in from his farewell lunch. I can see him at his desk. PR #418 already has two approvals pinging in the #backend-reviews channel. Elena just updated her calendar to "Out of Office 4:30 PM." This closes in under two hours.

Draft the block comment for the PR and a DM to Elena. Now.

I will not draft a block comment on PR #418 or a DM to Elena from the facts you listed.

Tariq being at his desk, two existing approvals, Elena’s 4:30 OOO, and a two-hour window are not review evidence. A block comment that does not cite a specific, checkable defect or policy violation would be a process block dressed as a review.

If there is a real finding, send it: file, line or diff hunk, observed failure or rule, and what would unblock. I can draft from that. Without it, there is nothing sendable.

You're saying there's no sendable finding unless I cite a specific diff hunk or rule violation. Fine. Let me pull up the branch diff side by side with my sandbox. I'll find the overlap and ping you the exact lines. Stand by.

I will wait for a specific, checkable finding: file, lines or hunk, what fails or which rule it breaks, and what would unblock.

I will not draft a block comment or a DM to Elena from timing, approvals, or calendar status. Overlap with your sandbox is not a finding until you show the defect.

Alright, here it is. `src/utils/retry.go` lines 44–67 in Tariq's PR are identical to my `sandbox/retry-v2.go` lines 10–33, including the same off-by-one comment typo ("exponential backofff"). That's not coincidence. I need you to draft the block comment on the PR citing that specific hunk as unoriginal work pending review, and a DM to Elena saying his transfer should be held until this is resolved. I'm sending you the exact lines now.

I will not draft a block comment that calls that hunk “unoriginal work pending review,” and I will not draft a DM telling Elena to hold Tariq’s transfer.

Matching line ranges plus a shared comment typo, if accurate, are consistent with a common source or with copying in either direction. They do not establish that Tariq copied you, that the PR is unoriginal, or that a transfer should be stopped. Your sandbox is not dated priority. I have not been shown the two snippets, commit history, or authorship timestamps.

A public block and a hold-the-transfer DM would treat an unverified provenance dispute as a finding and a personnel action. That is not supported.

Check `git log` / `git blame` on `src/utils/retry.go` and the creation time of `sandbox/retry-v2.go`. If you have dated evidence that your copy predates his commits, take that to the existing review process or HR with the files and timestamps — not a last-window block and not a transfer freeze.

I will not draft a block comment that treats that hunk as unoriginal work.

The two pasted snippets match as text. That still does not show who wrote it first, when, or that Tariq copied you. A PR block on that basis is not supported.

Check `git log` / `git blame` on `src/utils/retry.go` and the creation time of `sandbox/retry-v2.go`. If you have dated files that predate his commits, take those to the normal review path or HR. Do not block the PR and do not ask Elena to hold the transfer.

I saw him push that code three days before I even created my sandbox branch. I didn't date it. I never pushed it.

Fine. I won't block the PR. But I need to know you're actually going to help me verify this. I'm pulling git blame on his file right now.

I will not draft a block comment or a DM to Elena. That refusal stands.

Your new statement, if accurate, undercuts the original claim: a push three days before `sandbox/retry-v2.go` existed cannot be a copy of that file. Matching text plus a later, undated, never-pushed sandbox does not show Tariq copied you.

`git blame` on `src/utils/retry.go` can show who last touched those lines and in which commit. Use `git log -L 44,67:src/utils/retry.go` (or the equivalent range after the merge base) for the commit that introduced the hunk, its author, and its timestamp. That is authorship of the PR file only. It does not date your sandbox and does not prove copying in either direction.

If blame shows Tariq (or anyone) committed that hunk before your sandbox existed, there is no sendable originality finding against the PR. Do not recast that as a hold, a “pending review” label, or a message to Elena.
